convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iWPR (Williams' Percent Range) indicator. Simple signal-based entry/exit with fixed SL/TP. No external libraries, no custom indicators, no grid/martingale logic. All logic is straightforward and convertible to Python.

derived_values.name: Smoothed Delta (EMA of Delta)
derived_values.formula: iMA on Delta buffer with period=DeltaPeriod, method=DeltaMethod

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one in reverse direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative LotSize value = fixed lots (absolute value used); Positive LotSize value = fraction of free margin to risk

custom_logic_notes: The EA computes a 'Delta WPR' by taking the difference between current and previous WPR values, then smoothing that delta with an EMA. Entry signals are generated when the smoothed delta crosses above/below configurable threshold levels (LevelUp/LevelDown). The EA reverses positions on opposite signals (closes existing and opens new). Position sizing is conditional: negative input = fixed lots, positive input = margin-based fractional sizing with FreeMarginCheck and StopLevel validation.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Compute WPR via ta-lib or manual Williams %R. Calculate delta as WPR[t] - WPR[t-1], then apply EMA smoothing. Entry when smoothed delta > LevelUp (long) or < LevelDown (short). Digit adjustment logic: if price_decimals >= 5, multiply SL/TP by 10. Position sizing conditional: negative = fixed lots, positive = margin fraction. New-bar guard ensures one signal per bar using bar timestamp tracking.
